title: MetaParser v2 Schema
description: Schema definition for MetaParser .metaparser.json files. Defines tokens and patterns for text parser generation.

$schema.description: Reference to this JSON schema for IDE validation

namespace.description: The .NET namespace for generated parser code

classname.description: The class name prefix for generated parser classes. If not specified, defaults to 'Parser'

tokens.description: Token definitions. Keys are token names, values are token definitions. Definition order determines priority (earlier = higher priority).

propertyNames.description: Token names should be lowercase with hyphens or underscores

trivia.description: Token names to treat as trivia (whitespace, comments). Trivia is attached to following tokens.

items.description: Name of a token defined in the tokens object

tokenDefinition.description: Defines a token type with patterns for matching input

start.description: Pattern that must match to begin consuming this token. Consumed as part of the token.

consume.description: Pattern(s) to consume repeatedly after the start pattern matches.

stop.description: Pattern that ends consumption. The stop pattern is NOT consumed as part of this token.

escape.description: Pattern that escapes the next character/token, allowing it to be consumed literally.

pattern.description: A pattern for matching characters. Can be a literal string, a character range, a token reference, or an array combining multiple patterns.

literalPattern.description: Matches an exact sequence of characters

rangePattern.description: Matches any character within an inclusive range

range.description: Two-element array specifying [start, end] of character range (inclusive)

tokenReference.description: References another token's pattern by name

$token.description: Name of another token whose pattern should be matched

patternArray.description: Combines multiple patterns - matches if ANY pattern matches (OR semantics)
